title: euthamia hirtipes
intro: Euthamia hirtipes, commonly known as hairy inflorescence goldenglow, is a plant species native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Euthamia hirtipes include its ability to act as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful for treating various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
